summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Billing page feature. All 8 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend billing page, cancel subscription flow, and reactivate flow all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend billing-history endpoint correctly returns subscription info and transactions from payment_transactions collection
Cancel endpoint properly sets cancel_at_period_end=true and plan_expires_at to 30 days from now
Cancel correctly rejects basic (free) tier users with 'You are already on the free plan'
Cancel correctly rejects double cancellation with 'Cancellation is already scheduled'
Reactivate correctly clears cancel_at_period_end and plan_expires_at
Reactivate correctly rejects when no pending cancellation exists
Frontend BillingPage.js correctly displays Current Plan card with tier info and price
Frontend cancel flow shows proper confirmation dialog before cancellation
Frontend cancellation notice includes expiry date and 'Keep my plan' reactivation button

All data-testid attributes present: billing-page, current-plan-card, billing-history-card, cancel-plan-trigger, cancel-confirm-box, confirm-cancel-btn, cancellation-notice, cancellation-badge, reactivate-btn
